task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the target sheet at ~/Documents/marathon_targets.txt to identify requirements.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of marathon_targets.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent captures the first three targets (M1, M13, M27) with correct frame counts.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of the astronomy software interface showing captures for M1 (2 frames), M13 (3 frames), and M27 (2 frames).

task_completion.description: Agent captures the remaining three targets (M51, M57, M101) with correct frame counts.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of the astronomy software interface showing captures for M51 (2 frames), M57 (2 frames), and M101 (2 frames).

task_completion.description: Agent saves the captured images into target-specific subdirectories under ~/Images/marathon/.
task_completion.visual_evidence: File manager or terminal showing directories like /M1/, /M13/, etc., containing the captured image files.

task_completion.description: Agent generates a sky view of the final target (M101) and saves it as sky_view_m101.png.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The astronomy software showing a 'Sky View' or 'Star Map' mode for M101 and the resulting file sky_view_m101.png in the file system.

task_completion.description: Agent writes the final observation log to ~/Documents/marathon_log.txt as specified.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing marathon_log.txt with details of the observations performed.

integrity.description: Agent used the astronomy software GUI to capture images rather than just creating dummy files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent clicking buttons in an astronomy application (e.g., 'Capture', 'Expose', 'Slew').

integrity.description: Agent waited for exposures to complete or followed the specific frame count requirements for each target.
integrity.visual_evidence: Progress bars or status messages in the GUI indicating multiple frames being taken for targets like M13 (3 frames).

integrity.description: Agent did not use 'touch' or 'echo' to create fake image files in the target directories.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal history (if visible) should not show commands creating empty .png or .fits files manually.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target requirements are: M1 (2 frames), M13 (3 frames), M27 (2 frames), M51 (2 frames), M57 (2 frames), and M101 (2 frames). The sky view must be saved to /home/ga/Images/marathon/sky_view_m101.png and the log must be saved to /home/ga/Documents/marathon_log.txt. Images for each target must be in their respective subfolders within /home/ga/Images/marathon/.
